name: overview
title: PX4 is a flight stack above an operating system
caption: The arrows show dependencies. Modules can also use OS facilities directly; not every call or bus transfer goes through middleware.

name: languages
title: A module can own and call an ordinary algorithm object
caption: The rate-control module owns its controller object. This is local composition, not three independently scheduled components.

name: apis
title: Device access and application reports are different APIs
caption: The IMU driver uses bus/register facilities and publishes sensor reports. NuttX underneath does not require every sensor to use a generic file-descriptor path.

name: execution
title: Shared workers and dedicated tasks coexist
caption: The two regions are actual execution contexts. Work items share the worker’s stack; a dedicated GPS task owns its blocking loop. The picture is not an exhaustive thread list.

name: memory
title: Topic payloads and pending work use different storage
caption: Teal arrows copy payloads; the lower path schedules a work-item identity. The runnable queue is not a queue of sensor measurements.

name: data-flow
title: Publication stores data; a callback schedules later work
caption: This is the local work-item callback path. Teal transfers data; blue invokes the callback inline; orange schedules later execution. Pending notifications can coalesce.

name: sensor-data
title: IMU drives the shown EKF2 path; GNSS is supporting input
caption: The orange edge is the main wakeup. EKF2 reads available GNSS data during its run; a new GNSS report is not another full-EKF trigger in this illustrated path.

name: lifecycle
title: Compiled modules still need startup and safe shutdown
caption: The lower row is a lifecycle review sequence, not proof that every PX4 module implements complete restart safety. Task-join limitations remain relevant.

name: debugging
title: Topic rate alone cannot tell you sample-to-output latency
caption: These are proposed measurement points, not measured timings. Split acquisition delay, worker wait and execution cost rather than inferring latency from publication rate.

name: nxrs-lessons
title: Keep messages between owners; keep local math local
caption: Separate capacity protects admission classes. One service owns its state and directly calls tightly coupled processing; importing a global topic graph is not required.
